d.ko: “People think battles need powerful weapons, but strategy at hand is key."The story follows a rookie adventurer and a new healer in a dungeon quest, with the core gameplay involving hand-picked methods using weapons and items. Fight or purify? Heal or alter? The choice is in your hands.
d.en: “People think battles need powerful weapons, but strategy at hand is key."The story follows a rookie adventurer and a new healer in a dungeon quest, with the core gameplay involving hand-picked methods using weapons and items. Fight or purify? Heal or alter? The choice is in your hands.
d.zh: “人们一直有一个误区，认为战斗最重要的是神兵利器……不，最重要的是手法。”  本作以角色的“手法”与不同武器、道具的配合为核心玩法，讲述一位新晋勇者与一位刚刚转职的治疗术士的地下城探险故事。消灭，又或是净化魔物？治愈伤痛，或者改写故事？一切将交给你来抉择。
